semiconductor_relevance: Low — EM-Technik GmbH primarily manufactures fittings and connectors made of special plastics, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: EM-Technik GmbH specializes in high-quality fittings and connectors for handling aggressive media flows, with a focus on material purity and reliability. Their products are tailored for various applications, including those in controlled environments compliant with high-purity standards.
capabilities: Manufacturing of high-purity fittings and connectors
Production of valves and flow meters
Development of filtration systems for liquid and gaseous media
